h1: Custom Screen Print Caps for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Screen Print Caps | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom screen print caps in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Durable, vibrant logos on caps for teams, events, and promotions.
introHtml: Screen printing is the go-to decoration method for caps when you need bold, long-lasting logos at scale. Unlike embroidery, screen print delivers vivid colors and sharp details on cotton or polyester fronts, making it ideal for large event runs, safety crew uniforms, or promotional giveaways where cost per unit matters. The flat printing surface on cap panels ensures consistent ink coverage, so your brand stands out clearly from any angle.
heroAltText: Custom screen print caps with vibrant logo imprint on front panels for bulk promotional orders
